description: Home Assistant integration for LG webOS TVs, built on the bscpylgtv library with one push websocket per TV.
author: belikh

glossary.SSAP: Second Screen Application Protocol, the websocket API a webOS TV exposes to companion apps. The integration sends every command through it.
glossary.Pairing key: The client key a TV issues after you accept the pairing prompt. Home Assistant stores it in the config entry and sends it on every connection.
glossary.Wake-on-LAN: A UDP magic packet sent to the TV's MAC address. It is the only way to turn a webOS TV on from Home Assistant.
glossary.ARC: Audio Return Channel, the HDMI path that carries TV audio to a soundbar.
glossary.Compatibility mode: Registration with an unsigned manifest. The integration switches to it when a webOS 26 TV rejects the signed manifest.
